proposals.before: Collating ancient books, there are no such two characters at all; this is simply a vulgar scholar adding and subtracting at will.

proposals.before: The Liji · Mingtangwei says: "The Son of Heaven's temple has double eaves and layered roofs."

proposals.reason: 複廟重簷 is double temple (複廟) plus layered eaves (重簷); the idiomatic line swaps those senses.

proposals.before: Husizheng held Baicheng in Goguryeo. Yan Pi attacked it for two days, then an edict ordered him recalled.

decisions.reason: 複廟重簷 is double temple plus layered eaves; the original English swaps those terms, while the next unit glosses 複廟 as 重屋.
覲禮經 is the Audience Rites classic (Jinli jing); Jingli misreads 覲, and the idiomatic gloss is accurate.
The literal field repeats the same false Jingli romanization of 覲禮經; Jinli jing is the correct reading without adding unstated gloss.
漢官 is the Han offices text; Hangguan fuses the two syllables and is not a source title.
起部承務郎 is Chengwulang in the Ministry of Works, not an attendant post in the Ministry of Personnel; 少子溫 is otherwise correctly rendered.
閻毗 appears once; the literal doubling of Yan Pi has no Chinese counterpart, and 榆林盛樂人也 is otherwise intact.
起部郎 is a lang post in the Ministry of Works; rendering it as Attendant of the Ministry of Personnel misidentifies both the ministry and the rank.
This unit is Yan Pi's own 今憲章往古 closing, ended by 」; the extra inner quote mark wrongly keeps a nested citation open through a sentence that is not Hong's twelve-chariot proposal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 今憲章往古，大駕依秦，法駕依漢，小駕依宋，以為差等。」

decisions.reason: 右翊衛長史 is the Right Yiwei Guard; Yiwu is a false reading of 翊衛.
The literal field has the same false Yiwu reading of 翊衛; Yiwei is required here as in the idiomatic repair.
政 continues 斛斯政 as Husi Zheng, and 柏崖城 is Baiya city, not Baicheng; both names in the original are source-false.
卒 records only that he died after the Tang appointment; English 'there' invents a place of death absent from 歸於大唐，授將作少匠，卒.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 歸於大唐，授將作少匠，卒。
